text: Anndee pellet, Allah wuurnitay leydi ndin fuɗingol ndi si ndi yoorii. Gomɗii Men ɓannginiranii on onon ɓee yimɓe, dalilaaji e hujjaaji fii kattal Allah e gootaagu Makko ngun, fii no haqqiliron, anndon wonnde wuurnituɗo ndin leydi On, ko hattanɗo wuurnitugol on si on maayii, ko non kadi O waawiri haccinde ɓerɗe mon ɗen si ɗe yoorii.
